task.description: Validate the design artefact at src/design/svc-01-04-service-scope.md against all acceptance criteria for SVC-01, SVC-02, SVC-03, and SVC-04. Hard gate — BACKEND-DEV and FRONTEND-DEV cannot start until this returns PASS.
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in SVC-01..04 has a corresponding design element
No implementation code present in the design artefact
SVC-01 migration scope columns and constraint are fully specified
SVC-02 PluginScope enum, nullable owner_tenant_id, dispatch filter, and duplicate check are specified
SVC-03 activation validation flow (catalog + plugin check, atomicity, timing) is fully specified
SVC-04 all 5 API endpoints and the admin UI page spec are present

result.summary: All design artefacts for SVC-01 through SVC-04 validated — lint exits 0 on all 3 artefacts (Type E prose, Type C migration YAML, Type B list-page YAML); both codegen dry-runs exit 0; migration number 078 confirmed available; all MUST acceptance criteria are covered by design elements; request_schema and response_schema fields present in create_form; no implementation code in prose design; error taxonomy, public signatures, data-flow diagrams, and dependency order complete.

issues.description: Migration dry-run (codegen_migration.py) does not emit the column-level CHECK (scope IN ('global', 'tenant')) nor the table-level ck_service_scope_owner constraint — known codegen limitation. Design document (src/design/svc-01-04-service-scope.md §6) explicitly acknowledges this and instructs BACKEND-DEV to add both constraints in the -- CUSTOM: block of the generated migration file. YAML spec fully documents both constraints.
